CMOS_REFERENCES.swing_note: QAL at 1.65 V vs CMOS at 1.2 V is the PRIMARY and non-flattering comparison; the swing is a requirement of QAL, not a free parameter.

_time_keys.stage_time_ps: MEASURED bank3-valid minus bank2-valid, the end-to-end level time actually observed
_time_keys.T_ps: the SCHEDULED beat from the committed analytic rule T = ceil10(TZ8*sqrt(N/8)*sqrt(s)*sqrt(L/15) + 73.5), which reproduces Phase 1's accepted T at every N

MATCHED_PAIR_same_tank_same_switch._why: C_bank_nominal = 35.979*(N/8)*s, so (N=8,s=8) and (N=64,s=1) have IDENTICAL nominal C_bank (287.832 fF), IDENTICAL C_tank (2878.32 fF) and IDENTICAL switch width (84.853 um). The resonant cost is the same by construction and the ONLY difference is how it is SPENT: 8 gates of 8x width, or 64 gates of 1x width. This is the user's challenge in its cleanest form.
